exact_quote: Our decision comes at a time when the American economy appears to be strengthening. New hiring, private-sector earnings, business capital investment-each of these markers has improved in recent months and is pointing in a good direction. Credit flows have been robust, particularly for businesses. And, as I said at the policy symposium in Jackson Hole, I would be hard pressed to describe broad financial conditions as restrictive. This view was widely shared by the Committee. So we removed a dose of accommodation.
